feed.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion

entry.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion
entry.summary:
Lithos Protocol offers a blockchain-agnostic and fully decentralized solution that addresses critical challenges in distributed mining pools. Its architecture prioritizes scalability, positioning it as one of the most scalable decentralized pools available. Payout granularity and coinbase output management are optimized, allowing for streamlined distributions through mechanisms such as single atomic swaps to Ergo, reducing complexity and inefficiency.
Settlement of blocks can be achieved by implementing a trustless bitcoin relay, ensuring secure and transparent validation across chains. Further technical details, resources, and updates about Lithos Protocol can be accessed at [lithosprotocol.org](http://lithosprotocol.org).
